Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.description: Pomobox Privacy Policy - How we collect, use, and protect your data

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to Pomobox. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our service.

accountInfo.title: 2.1 Account Information (Registered Users)
accountInfo.content: When you create an account, we collect:
items: Encrypted password (hashed, not stored in plain text)
Google OAuth information (if you sign in with Google): Provider ID, email address, and profile image

activityData.title: 2.2 User Activity Data (Registered Users)
activityData.content: When you use Pomobox while logged in, we collect:
items: Daily statistics (date, session count, total focus minutes)

localStorage.title: 2.3 Local Storage (All Users)
localStorage.content: For users who are not logged in, we store data locally in your browser using localStorage. This data includes:
localStorage.note: This data never leaves your device and is not accessible to us. You can clear this data at any time through your browser settings.

automatic.title: 2.4 Automatically Collected Information
automatic.content: When you use Pomobox, we may automatically collect:

cookies.title: 2.5 Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies for authentication and to improve your experience. Essential cookies are required for the service to function properly.

supabase.title: 3.1 Supabase
supabase.content: We use Supabase as our database and authentication provider. Supabase stores your account information and activity data on secure servers.

vercel.title: 3.2 Vercel
vercel.content: Our website is hosted on Vercel. Vercel may collect anonymous usage data and logs.

adsense.title: 3.3 Google AdSense
adsense.content: We use Google AdSense to display advertisements. Google may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this or other websites. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting

resend.title: 3.4 Resend
resend.content: We use Resend as our email delivery service for sending authentication and notification emails (such as password reset links and account verification).

usage.title: 4. How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use the collected information to:
items: Authenticate your account and keep you signed in
Sync your focus data across devices (registered users)

registered.title: 5.1 Registered Users
registered.content: Your account and activity data is stored on Supabase servers. We retain your data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your data will be permanently deleted immediately.

nonRegistered.title: 5.2 Non-Registered Users
nonRegistered.content: If you use Pomobox without an account, all your data is stored locally in your browser (localStorage). This data is not transmitted to our servers and remains on your device until you clear your browser data.

security.title: 6. Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your data:
items: All data is transmitted over HTTPS (encrypted connection)
Passwords are hashed using industry-standard algorithms
Database access is protected by Row Level Security (RLS) policies
We regularly review and update our security practices

gdpr.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
gdpr.content: If you are in the European Economic Area, you have the right to:

ccpa.title: 8. Your Rights (CCPA)
ccpa.content: If you are a California resident, you have the right to:
items: Know what personal information is collected
Know whether your personal information is sold or disclosed
Say no to the sale of personal information (we do not sell your data)
Request deletion of your personal information
Not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights

registered.title: 9.1 Registered Users
registered.content: You can permanently delete your account and all associated data at any time through the 'Delete Account' option in your My Account page. The deletion is immediate and irreversible.

nonRegistered.title: 9.2 Non-Registered Users
steps: Navigate to Privacy or Site Settings
Find and clear site data for pomobox.app
nonRegistered.note: Alternatively, you can clear all browsing data or use your browser's developer tools to clear localStorage.

children.title: 10. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this privacy policy or want to exercise your data rights, please contact us at:

meta.title: Pomodoro Technique: Complete Guide to Time Management
meta.description: Learn the Pomodoro Technique - a proven time management method developed in the 1980s. Discover how 25-minute focus sessions can boost your productivity.

hero.title: Pomodoro Technique: Complete Guide to Time Management
hero.subtitle: A scientifically proven method to boost focus and productivity

whatIs.title: What is the Pomodoro Technique?
whatIs.content: The Pomodoro Technique is a time management method developed by Francesco Cirillo in the late 1980s. Named after the tomato-shaped kitchen timer he used as a university student, this technique has helped millions worldwide improve their focus and productivity.

howTo.title: How to Use the Pomodoro Timer (Step-by-Step)

step1.title: Create Your Task List
step1.desc: Write down what you need to accomplish

step3.title: Work on the Task
step3.desc: Give your full attention until the timer rings

step5.title: Repeat & Long Break
step5.desc: After 4 sessions, take a 15-30 minute break

whyWorks.title: Why 25 Minutes Focus and 5 Minutes Rest?

benefit1.title: Prevents Burnout
benefit1.desc: Regular breaks keep your mind fresh

benefit4.title: Flow State
benefit4.desc: Structured intervals help achieve deep focus

feature2.title: Dashboard Stats
feature2.desc: Track your achievements and stay motivated

feature3.title: Calendar & Streaks
feature3.desc: Build lasting habits with visual progress

q1.q: Can I customize the timer durations?
q1.a: Yes! Adjust focus and break times to match your personal rhythm in Settings.

q2.q: What should I do during breaks?
q2.a: Stretch, rest your eyes, grab water, or take a short walk. Avoid screens if possible.
